extension.description: WebStorm-like Git commit management panel for VS Code
configuration.commitMessageLanguage.desc: Language used when generating commit messages with the configured provider.
configuration.commitMessageModel.descrip: Copilot model ID used to generate commit messages. Leave empty to choose on the next generation, or run `GitMin: Select Commit Message Model` to select from currently available models.
configuration.customModel.enabled.descri: Use an OpenAI-compatible third-party model for commit message generation instead of Copilot. [Set or replace the API key](command:gitmin.setCustomModelApiKey); it is stored securely and never written to `settings.json`.
configuration.customModel.baseUrl.descri: OpenAI-compatible Base URL or full Chat Completions endpoint. For example, enter `https://api.example.com/v1` or `https://api.example.com/v1/chat/completions`; GitMin only appends `/chat/completions` when needed.
configuration.customModel.model.descript: Model ID sent to the OpenAI-compatible API.
configuration.commitMessagePrompt.descri: Additional instructions appended to the built-in commit message prompt. The staged diff and output language rules are supplied automatically.
command.openPanel.title: GitMin: Open Panel in Editor
command.openSettings.title: GitMin: Open Settings
command.selectCommitMessageModel.title: GitMin: Select Commit Message Model
command.setCustomModelApiKey.title: GitMin: Set Custom Model API Key
command.previousFileDiff.title: GitMin: Previous File Diff
command.nextFileDiff.title: GitMin: Next File Diff
